title: Is ISIS Back on the Rise?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报 Dealbook 负责商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 在11月18日，我将在纽约市的 Dealbook 峰会上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的一些领导人，其中包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、

sentences.en: Christine Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日于 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔维内西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Three years after the
sentences.zh: 在美国宣布战胜

sentences.en: United States declared victory over the Islamic State.
sentences.zh: 伊斯兰国三年后，

sentences.en: A well-organized attack in northern Syria is raising questions about whether the terror group could be on the cusp of a resurgence.
sentences.zh: 叙利亚北部的一场有组织的袭击引发了人们的疑问：这个恐怖组织是否正处于死灰复燃的边缘？

sentences.en: My colleague, Jane Araf, traveled to the site of the battle.
sentences.zh: 我的同事简·阿拉夫前往了战斗现场。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 3rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月3日，星期四。

sentences.en: Jane, you've been in Syria reporting on an ISIS attack that started about two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 简，你一直在叙利亚报道大约两周前开始的一起 ISIS 袭击事件。

sentences.en: Tell us how it began.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲它是如何开始的吧。

sentences.en: Well, this was, first of all, really the biggest confrontation between ISIS and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 好的，首先，这实际上是自2019年伊斯兰国垮台以来，

sentences.en: and its allied forces since the fall of the Islamic State in 2019.
sentences.zh: ISIS 与美国及其盟军之间最大规模的对抗。

sentences.en: That's when ISIS lost the last of its territory and what it called the caliphate.
sentences.zh: 当时 ISIS 失去了最后的领土，也就是他们所说的哈里发国。

sentences.en: What happened was that the news suddenly broke out that
sentences.zh: 当时的情况是，突然爆出新闻说

sentences.en: ISIS fighters were attacking a prison complex in northeast Syria.
sentences.zh: ISIS 武装分子正在袭击叙利亚东北部的一个监狱综合体。

sentences.en: Live on a Middle East Bureau with more on this.
sentences.zh: 中东记者站正进行关于此事的更多报道。

sentences.en: More than 100 gunmen assaulted a prison in northeastern Syria where some 3,000 ISIS militants were being held.
sentences.zh: 100多名枪手袭击了叙利亚东北部的一座监狱，那里关押着大约3000名 ISIS 武装分子。

sentences.en: Kurdish forces who control the area say a car bomb struck the prison gates as detainees began rioting.
sentences.zh: 控制该地区的库尔德武装表示，当被关押者开始暴动时，一枚汽车炸弹袭击了监狱大门。

sentences.en: It's a prison in this residential neighborhood in the middle of a city, actually, a city called Hasakah, which holds suspected ISIS members.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这是一座位于城市中心住宅区内的监狱，这座城市叫哈塞克，关押着疑似 ISIS 成员。

sentences.en: Dozens of militants staged a riot inside the prison to create a scene of chaos.
sentences.zh: 数十名武装分子在监狱内发动暴动，制造混乱的场面。

sentences.en: The attackers outside, which included gunmen and suicide bombers, were trying to break out the prisoners inside.
sentences.zh: 外面的袭击者包括枪手和自杀式袭击者，他们试图救出里面的囚犯。

sentences.en: Many of the guards were being held hostage by ISIS, making it difficult to liberate the complex.
sentences.zh: 许多警卫被 ISIS 劫为人质，这使得解放该综合体变得十分困难。

sentences.en: And it became apparent pretty quickly that this was not one of those attacks that would be put down easily and everyone would move on.
sentences.zh: 很快人们就明显看出来，这不是那种能够轻易平息、大家就能翻篇的袭击。

sentences.en: We saw that the forces guarding the prison, those are the U.S.-backed Kurdish-led forces called the SDF, or Syrian Democratic Forces, were struggling to defend it.
sentences.zh: 我们看到，负责守卫监狱的部队——即美国支持的、以库尔德人为主导的名为叙利亚民主军（SDF）的部队——正在艰难地进行防御。

sentences.en: The Americans have been involved as well, providing air support as well as airstrikes.
sentences.zh: 美国人也参与其中，提供了空中支援和空袭。

sentences.en: And what really caught our attention was not just the nature of this attack and the size of this attack, it was that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 真正引起我们注意的不仅仅是这次袭击的性质和规模，而是美国

sentences.en: sent in ground forces.
sentences.zh: 派出了地面部队。

sentences.en: The first time in a long time we'd heard that.
sentences.zh: 这是很长一段时间以来我们听说的第一次。

sentences.en: So we were monitoring this in Baghdad for a few days, and then we decided we really needed to get there on the ground and see what was going on.
sentences.zh: 因此我们在巴格达监控了几天的局势，然后决定必须实地前往那里看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: So we drove for 14 hours to get to northeastern
sentences.zh: 于是我们开车14个小时来到了叙利亚

sentences.en: Syria.
sentences.zh: 东北部。

sentences.en: And we went as quickly as we could to the site of the prison in a city called Hasika.
sentences.zh: 我们以最快的速度赶往哈塞克市的监狱现场。

sentences.en: That's the sound of explosions coming from the prison still.
sentences.zh: 那是从监狱传出的爆炸声。

sentences.en: We're just down the road from it.
sentences.zh: 我们就在离它不远的路边。

sentences.en: And as we were driving around, we kept hearing these explosions.
sentences.zh: 当我们开车四处转时，不断听到这些爆炸声。

sentences.en: There were American armored vehicles rushing towards the prison, so clearly the fighting isn't over yet.
sentences.zh: 有美国的装甲车正冲向监狱，所以显然战斗还没有结束。

sentences.en: There were fighter jets flying overhead.
sentences.zh: 头顶上有战斗机在飞行。

sentences.en: And there were security forces, SWAT teams, counter-terrorism teams going through the neighborhoods around the prison.
sentences.zh: 有安全部队、特警队和反恐部队在监狱周围的街区穿梭。

sentences.en: There were people fleeing neighborhoods and other people trying to get back to their neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 有人正逃离街区，也有人试图返回自己的街区。

sentences.en: They were dragging small children with them and carrying loaves of bread.
sentences.zh: 他们拉着年幼的孩子，手里提着面包。

sentences.en: I'm actually looking at burning oil tankers.
sentences.zh: 我实际上正看着燃烧的油罐车。

sentences.en: It seems that there was an airstrike here.
sentences.zh: 这里似乎发生过空袭。

sentences.en: And we started driving around where there were clearing operations going on.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在正在进行清剿行动的地方开车四处查看。

sentences.en: Clearing operations is where security forces go in and they go house to house.
sentences.zh: 清剿行动是指安全部队进入并挨家挨户搜查。

sentences.en: They're looking for escaped prisoners and for ISIS fighters.
sentences.zh: 他们在寻找逃跑的囚犯和 ISIS 武装分子。

sentences.en: And then we go a little bit away and
sentences.zh: 然后我们稍微走远了一点，

sentences.en: there's a front-end loader.
sentences.zh: 看到了一台前置装载机。

sentences.en: We're looking at a bulldozer that's just brought a load of dead bodies
sentences.zh: 我们看到一辆推土机刚刚运来一车尸体

sentences.en: and dumped them in the middle of the street.
sentences.zh: 并将它们倾倒在街中央。

sentences.en: They say they're ISIS fighters that were killed in the prison.
sentences.zh: 他们说这些是在监狱中被杀死的 ISIS 武装分子。

sentences.en: And now you can hear the bulldozer approaching.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以听到推土机靠近的声音。

sentences.en: It's actually picking them up and dumping them into another vehicle to take them away.
sentences.zh: 它实际上正在把尸体铲起来，倒进另一辆车里运走。

sentences.en: There are just piles of bodies.
sentences.zh: 那里堆满了尸体。

sentences.en: The pile that I'm looking at is maybe about 10, 15 bodies.
sentences.zh: 我看到的这堆尸体大概有10到15具。

sentences.en: Some of them were wearing prison uniforms to clearly escape prisoners.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人穿着囚服，显然是越狱的囚犯。

sentences.en: This is kind of, this image is beyond belief.
sentences.zh: 这种画面简直让人难以置信。

sentences.en: These are ISIS.
sentences.zh: 这些都是 ISIS 成员。

sentences.en: We killed them from the prison.
sentences.zh: 我们把他们从监狱里消灭了。

sentences.en: You know, we asked about this, and we were told,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们询问了这事，得到的回答是：

sentences.en: We know this isn't right, but there are just so many of them.
sentences.zh: 我们知道这样做不对，但他们人数实在太多了。

sentences.en: It was an absolutely surreal scene.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其超现实的场景。

sentences.en: And it was an indication of how intense the fighting was.
sentences.zh: 这也表明了战斗是多么激烈。

sentences.en: And that was when I realized that this was a much bigger deal.
sentences.zh: 就在那时我意识到，这是一个严重得多的问题。

sentences.en: This fighting was on a much bigger scale than it had seemed.
sentences.zh: 这场战斗的规模比看上去要大得多。

sentences.en: So Jane, you're watching this incredible scene.
sentences.zh: 简，你正在目睹这个令人难以置信的场景。

sentences.en: And after days and days of fighting in this town, how does the battle come to an end?
sentences.zh: 在这座城镇经历了数天的战斗之后，这场战役是如何结束的？

sentences.en: Well, it comes to an end more than a week after it started, which, when you think of it, is an incredibly long time for a prison siege to be unfolding.
sentences.zh: 它在开始一周多后结束，如果你想想的话，这对于一场监狱围困战来说是极其漫长的时间。

sentences.en: And it comes to an end after we're told by the Kurdish-led forces that they gave them an ultimatum.
sentences.zh: 它的结束是因为以库尔德人为主导的部队告诉我们，他们向对方下了最后通牒。

sentences.en: They said, either give up or essentially, we will kill you.
sentences.zh: 他们说，要么投降，否则基本上我们就消灭你们。

sentences.en: And according to the Kurdish forces, they said the prisoners, the gunmen gave up.
sentences.zh: 根据库尔德部队的说法，他们称囚犯和枪手投降了。

sentences.en: We don't really know what happened in those final moments.
sentences.zh: 我们并不真正知道在最后关头发生了什么。

sentences.en: We just have their account.
sentences.zh: 我们只有他们的叙述。

sentences.en: But they say that they essentially surrendered because they were surrounded and realized that there was no other option.
sentences.zh: 但他们说，对方基本上是选择投降，因为他们被包围了，意识到已经别无选择。

sentences.en: Okay, but why is this happening?
sentences.zh: 好吧，但这究竟为什么会发生？

sentences.en: I mean, the last news I remember was that ISIS was vanquished.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我记得的最新消息是 ISIS 已经被击溃了。

sentences.en: The caliphate was over.
sentences.zh: 哈里发国已经结束了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was over in the sense that it no longer held territory.
sentences.zh: 是的，它在不再拥有领土的意义上是结束了。

sentences.en: I mean, it went from controlling a third of Iraq and parts of Syria to basically being territorially defeated, driven out of the last piece of territory it held in 2019.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，它从控制伊拉克三分之一的领土和叙利亚的部分地区，变成了基本上在领土上被击败，并在2019年被驱逐出其控制的最后一块领土。

sentences.en: But it didn't entirely go away.
sentences.zh: 但它并没有完全消失。

sentences.en: The fighters retreated.
sentences.zh: 武装分子撤退了。

sentences.en: They went to the mountains.
sentences.zh: 他们去了山区。

sentences.en: They went to the desert.
sentences.zh: 他们去了沙漠。

sentences.en: They went to sleeper cells.
sentences.zh: 他们加入了潜伏细胞。

sentences.en: Now, it's been off the front pages.
sentences.zh: 现在，它已经不在头版头条上了。

sentences.en: It really takes a huge attack with a lot of casualties, really, to get a lot of attention these days, if we're talking about an ISIS attack or anything else.
sentences.zh: 说实话，如今如果要引起广泛关注，无论是关于 ISIS 的袭击还是其他什么，真的需要一起造成大量伤亡的大规模袭击才行。

sentences.en: But in Iraq, there are ISIS attacks almost every other day.
sentences.zh: 但在伊拉克，几乎每隔一天就会发生 ISIS 的袭击。

sentences.en: They might be an attack on a tribal leader's house.
sentences.zh: 可能是对部落领袖住所的袭击。

sentences.en: It might be an attack on
sentences.zh: 也可能是对

sentences.en: Iraqi security forces.
sentences.zh: 伊拉克安全部队的袭击。

sentences.en: But the attacks continue.
sentences.zh: 但袭击仍在继续。

sentences.en: So you're describing kind of small, low-level attacks.
sentences.zh: 所以你描述的是那种小型、低烈度的袭击。

sentences.en: Nothing as high profile as this prison siege.
sentences.zh: 没有什么像这次监狱围困那样备受瞩目。

sentences.en: Why did ISIS turn their attention here?
sentences.zh: 为什么 ISIS 会把注意力转向这里？

sentences.en: And why now?
sentences.zh: 又为什么是现在？

sentences.en: So to understand the importance, really, of this prison and this attack, we have to go back to 2019, where this started.
sentences.zh: 所以为了真正理解这座监狱和这次袭击的重要性，我们必须回到这一切开始的2019年。

sentences.en: In 2019, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在2019年，美国

sentences.en: and these Kurdish-led forces were taking back the last piece of ISIS territory.
sentences.zh: 和这些以库尔德人为主导的部队正在收复 ISIS 的最后一块领土。

sentences.en: There was weeks of bombing in the Syrian town where ISIS was holed up.
sentences.zh: 在 ISIS 盘踞的叙利亚小镇进行了数周的轰炸。

sentences.en: The people who survived the fighting there included tens of thousands of ISIS fighters and their families, women and children.
sentences.zh: 在那里幸存下来的人包括数万名 ISIS 武装分子及其家属，即妇女和儿童。

sentences.en: And as they all streamed out, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 当他们全部涌出时，美国

sentences.en: and the Kurdish-led forces had to figure out what to do with them.
sentences.zh: 和以库尔德人为主导的部队不得不琢磨该如何安置他们。

sentences.en: These people who had come to fight and to live in the self-described caliphate.
sentences.zh: 这些人曾赶来战斗并在自称的哈里发国里生活。

sentences.en: So what did the Kurdish-led forces do with all these families and the ISIS fighters who were left after the airstrikes?
sentences.zh: 那么以库尔德人为主导的部队是如何处理空袭后剩下的所有这些家属和 ISIS 武装分子的呢？

sentences.en: The families went to detention camps.
sentences.zh: 家属们被送往了拘留营。

sentences.en: There's one detention camp called El Hall, where there were about 60,000 people, mostly the wives and children of fighters.
sentences.zh: 有一个叫霍尔（Al-Hol）的拘留营，里面大约有6万名人员，主要是武装分子的妻子和孩子。

sentences.en: And many of those fighters had been killed.
sentences.zh: 而其中的许多武装分子已经被杀。

sentences.en: But they took all of the surviving ISIS fighters and they put them in these makeshift prisons in the region.
sentences.zh: 但他们把所有幸存的 ISIS 武装分子都关押在该地区的这些临时监狱里。

sentences.en: One of those became the prison in the city of Hasakah, the one that was attacked.
sentences.zh: 其中之一就变成了哈塞克市的监狱，也就是遭到袭击的那座。

sentences.en: The Kurdish-led forces looked around and they found this large complex, which had been a technical training institute, right in the middle of a residential neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 以库尔德人为主导的部队四处搜寻，发现了这座曾是技术培训学院的大型建筑群，它就位于住宅区的正中央。

sentences.en: And they turned that into a prison.
sentences.zh: 他们把这里改造成了一座监狱。

sentences.en: And they were thinking it might be temporary, that other countries, for instance, would take back their prisoners because some of them were foreigners.
sentences.zh: 他们当时认为这可能是临时的，比如其他国家会接回自己的囚犯，因为其中一些人是外国人。

sentences.en: They were thinking that perhaps the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们认为或许美国

sentences.en: and other countries could build them better prisons, you know, more secure prisons.
sentences.zh: 和其他国家可以为他们修建更好的监狱，你知道的，安全性更高的监狱。

sentences.en: And that didn't really happen.
sentences.zh: 但这一切并没有真正发生。

sentences.en: So you're saying that this Hasakah prison was never intended to be a permanent solution.
sentences.zh: 所以你是说，这座哈塞克监狱从一开始就没打算成为永久的解决方案。

sentences.en: But three years later, it's still there.
sentences.zh: 但三年后，它依然在那里。

sentences.en: Tell us what it's like.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲它是什么样子的吧。

sentences.en: So when I saw it, I was with NPR in 2019.
sentences.zh: 当我看到它时，我是在2019年跟随美国国家公共电台（NPR）去的。

sentences.en: And I saw it then.
sentences.zh: 我当时就看到了。

sentences.en: It looked like a former college.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像一所前大学。

sentences.en: It basically had these big rooms that had been turned into cells where people were packed like sardines inside.
sentences.zh: 它基本上有那些被改成牢房的大房间，里面的人像沙丁鱼一样挤在一起。

sentences.en: They didn't even have room to stretch.
sentences.zh: 他们连伸展身体的空间都没有。

sentences.en: The places that I saw, the cells that I saw, had very small windows.
sentences.zh: 我看到的地方、我看到的牢房，窗户都非常小。

sentences.en: There was almost no sunlight.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有阳光。

sentences.en: There was a very large room where the wounded were.
sentences.zh: 有一个关押伤员的大房间。

sentences.en: And most of them lying down because they were thin and sick.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数人躺着，因为又瘦又病。

sentences.en: And there was almost no medical care.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么医疗护理。

sentences.en: Again, these aren't prisons like we know prisons to be.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，这些不是我们所知道的那种监狱。

sentences.en: You know, those big purpose-built institutions that are heavily secured and there's wire around and high walls.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那些大型的、专门建造的、戒备森严、周围有铁丝网和高墙的机构。

sentences.en: These essentially are buildings that have been turned into detention facilities and prisons for what are considered some of the most dangerous people in the world.
sentences.zh: 这些基本上是被改造成拘留设施和监狱的建筑，用来关押被认为是世界上最危险的一些人。

sentences.en: And there was something else happening there as well, because these weren't just adult accused fighters.
sentences.zh: 那里还发生了另一件事，因为这里关押的不仅是成年被指控的武装分子。

sentences.en: There were 700 children in there under the age of 18.
sentences.zh: 里面还有700名18岁以下的儿童。

sentences.en: Wow, children.
sentences.zh: 哇，儿童。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: According to the SDF, they are child fighters.
